hints.title: Prefix Tree Autocomplete Ranking
hints.text: Store historical sentences and their frequency counts in a hierarchical prefix tree to stream top recommendations as characters are typed.

hints.title: Trie Node Sentence Frequency Map
hints.text: At each node along the typed path, maintain a mapping of sentences and their counts. Sort candidate matches by descending frequency and ascending lexicographical order.

hints.title: Autocomplete Blueprint
hints.text: When input char is "#": insert or increment current sentence count in tree, reset search buffer, return []. Otherwise append char, navigate down trie node, sort sentences by (-count, sentence), and return top 3.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: L: length of current typed prefix
complexity.notes: Trie descent takes O(L); sorting matching candidates takes O(M log M) where M is bound by dictionary size.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all historical sentences on every character keystroke degrades user input responsiveness.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Trie nodes cache sentence frequencies along prefixes for rapid subtree querying.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct tie-breaking by lexicographical order and handling the termination character "#".
